top.title: UAE Central Bank raises 2027 GDP growth forecast to 10.4%
top.teaser: The Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) has raised its growth forecast for next year to over 10 per cent, driven by both the oil and non-oil sectors. According to its latest Quarterly Economic Review, the UAE’s GDP is projected to grow by 10.4 per cent in 2027, compared with the 9.8 per cent growth it projected in its June Quarterly Economic Review. top.headline: UAE Central Bank Boosts 2027 GDP Forecast
top.summary: The Central Bank upgraded its 2027 growth projections to 10.4 percent based on strong oil and non-oil performance. This update reflects broader economic expansion across the Emirates.
